sloka: ततः कपिस्तान् ध्वजिनीपतीन् रणे निहत्य वीरान् सबलान् सवाहनान् ।समीक्ष्य वीरः परिगृह्य तोरणं कृतक्षणः काल इव प्रजाक्षये ।। ५.४६.३९।।
transliteration: tataḥ kapistān dhvajinīpatīn raṇe nihatya vīrān sabalān savāhanān ।samīkṣya vīraḥ parigṛhya toraṇaṁ kṛtakṣaṇaḥ kāla iva prajākṣaye ।। 5.46.39।।

translations.english: Then the heroic monkey having killed the army generals and their army and destroyed their vehicles in war came back to the archway after reviewing and stood like the timespirit bent upon the destruction of humanity. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे षट्चत्वारिंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the fortysixth sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
